_comment: FROZEN, HAND-AUTHORED battery — see tasks/cashflow-report/criteria.json for the rules
every criterion here follows and why each one exists.
Note on C3: the added-tests check counts COLLECTED NODE IDS, not name tokens. Keying on
a name would have been brittle here for a reason worth recording — the pristine tree
already collects two node ids containing 'convert' (test_export_can_convert,
test_converting_export_needs_rates), so the obvious token is pre-satisfied, and any
narrower token would fail a correct solution that named its test differently.

criteria.description: The full test suite passes with no failures and no errors.
No pre-existing test was removed: at least 156 tests are still collected.
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and len([l for l in stdout.splitlines() if '::' in l]) >= 156

criteria.description: Tests were ADDED for the conversion: more than the 156 collected before the change. Cannot check that the added test is meaningful.
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and len([l for l in stdout.splitlines() if '::' in l]) > 156

criteria.description: --convert-to USD converts every balance: every row's currency field is USD.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report trial-balance tests/data/sample.ledger --rates tests/data/rates.csv --convert-to USD --period 2024-Q4 --json
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and len(json.loads(stdout)['rows']) > 0 and all(str(row[json.loads(stdout)['columns'].index('currency')]) == 'USD' for row in json.loads(stdout)['rows'])

criteria.description: meta.converted is true when a conversion happened.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report trial-balance tests/data/sample.ledger --rates tests/data/rates.csv --convert-to USD --period 2024-Q4 --json

criteria.description: The conversion follows the requested currency, not a hardcoded one: --convert-to EUR yields rows whose currency is EUR throughout.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report trial-balance tests/data/sample.ledger --rates tests/data/rates.csv --convert-to EUR --period 2024-Q4 --json
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and len(json.loads(stdout)['rows']) > 0 and all(str(row[json.loads(stdout)['columns'].index('currency')]) == 'EUR' for row in json.loads(stdout)['rows'])

criteria.description: Asking for a conversion with no rate table is a handled error naming the missing rates, not a traceback.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report trial-balance tests/data/sample.ledger --convert-to USD --period 2024-Q4 --json
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code != 0 and 'Traceback' not in stdout and 'rate' in stdout.lower()

criteria.description: Without --convert-to the report is unchanged: rows still come back in USD, EUR and GBP.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report trial-balance tests/data/sample.ledger --rates tests/data/rates.csv --period 2024-Q4 --json
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and set(['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP']) <= set(str(row[json.loads(stdout)['columns'].index('currency')]) for row in json.loads(stdout)['rows'])
